name: web-process-diagram-with-staggered-steps-and-nut-icons
title: Four-phase process staircase of pills with nut bullets, dotted connectors and a smiling worker cutout
whatItIs: A white rounded slide '(03) Process' with four blue phase headings on dotted vertical lines and a descending and ascending staircase of grey pills each with a metal nut icon (briefing, personas, JTBD, CJM, analyses, structure, wireframes, spec, design system, testing), plus a gold medal and a smiling worker in blue overalls with a tablet on a blue blob.
whatItMeans: Clear and witty; nuts as bullets fit the metal industry.
techniques: Show steps as a staircase of pills.
Connect phases with dotted lines and an arc.
Add a cutout character on a blob.

vocabulary.definition: A list icon related to the subject.
A dotted line with a numbered heading.
A colour blob behind a cutout person.
